item.title: Be’er Sheva Opens All Public Shelters Amid Security Concerns
item.description: Shimon Tubul, deputy mayor of Be’er Sheva, announced that all public shelters across the city have been opened.

item.title: OpenAI Raises $110B, Reaches $730B Valuation in Record Funding Round
item.description: OpenAI has raised $110 billion in a new funding round that values the ChatGPT maker at $730 billion, its largest capital raise to date, strengthening its efforts to secure the computing power and talent needed to accelerate AI development.

item.title: 9-Vehicle Crash on Long Island Expressway Leaves 4 Injured, 1 Critical
item.description: A nine-vehicle collision occurred on the Long Island Expressway on Friday morning, leaving four people injured, including one in critical condition.

item.title: U.N. Nuclear Watchdog Unable to Verify Iran’s Enrichment Status As Regime Blocks Access To Bombed Nuclear Site
item.description: Iran has not allowed the United Nations nuclear agency access to its nuclear facilities bombed by Iran and the United States during a 12-day war in June, according to a confidential report by the watchdog circulated to member states and seen Friday by The Associated Press. item.title: BORO PARK: Manhole Fire in Destroys Van, FDNY on Scene
item.description: BORO PARK: A manhole fire erupted beneath a van at 17th Avenue and 45th Street, causing the vehicle to become fully engulfed in flames. FDNY firefighters are on the scene working to extinguish the blaze.

item.title: 🚨 Trump: Not Happy With Progress in Iran Talks
item.description: 🚨 Trump on talks with Iran: “I’m not happy with the fact that they’re not willing to give us what we have to have. I’m not thrilled with that. We’ll see what happens. We’re talking later… No, I’m not happy with the way they’re going.”

item.title: 🚨 Trump: No Final Decision on Iran, Unhappy With Negotiations
item.description: 🚨 Trump on Iran: “We haven’t made a final decision. We’re not exactly happy with the way they’re negotiating. They cannot have nuclear weapons… We’ll see how it all works out.”

item.title: 🚨 Trump: Would Prefer Diplomacy With Iran, Military Option Remains
item.description: 🚨 Trump on Iran: “It’d be nicer if we could do it without [the military], but sometimes you have to do it with. We have the greatest military anywhere in the world. There’s nothing close. I’d love not to use it, but sometimes you have to. We’ll see what happens.”
